xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF ingested from GitHub issue #2449

plan.title: Bug: xbrief implementation preflight command is unavailable in v0.74

narratives.Description: This story implements the cited GitHub issue acceptance criteria in the scoped packages listed in swarm.file_scope. It includes regression tests and a CHANGELOG entry under Unreleased Fixed or Changed as appropriate.
narratives.Overview: In a consumer using the xBRIEF lifecycle, the documented command 'deft xbrief:preflight -- <active xbrief path>' returns 'unknown verb'. The visible fallback 'deft vbrief:preflight' also rejects the positional path. This prevents agents from satisfying the documented implementation-intent gate for active xBRIEFs. Expected: xbrief:preflight works, or vbrief:preflight accepts the documented xbrief invocation with clear help text.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
Edit these concrete paths: packages/cli/src, packages/core/src, Taskfile.yml, tasks. Verify with: task --list. 1. Wire task xbrief:preflight as an alias or first-class verb that accepts the documented active xBRIEF path.
2. Ensure vbrief:preflight accepts xbrief/ paths with clear help when invoked with legacy name.
3. Add CLI/Taskfile tests and CHANGELOG.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent satisfying the implementation-intent gate, I want deft xbrief:preflight -- <path> to work, so that I can clear the #810 gate without unknown-verb failures.
narratives.Traces: missing_traces_justification: bugfix / security hardening without a mapped FR id in specification.xbrief.json

narrative.Acceptance: Given an active xBRIEF path, when task xbrief:preflight -- <path> runs, then exit 0 for running active stories and does not report unknown verb.
Given a bad invocation, when preflight fails, then stderr names the expected path form and lifecycle requirements.
Given CLI/Taskfile contract tests, when the suite runs, then xbrief:preflight wiring is asserted.
